changed.statement:
∀ T D : ℕ → ℕ, Filter.Tendsto T Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
  (∀ k, 2 ≤ D k) →
  Filter.Tendsto (fun k => (6*(T k : ℝ))/(2 : ℝ)^(D k)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
  Filter.Tendsto (fun k => (D k : ℝ)/(6*(T k : ℝ))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
  Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ =>
  letI : ∀ p : Prop, Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable
  let t := T k
  let d := D k
  let F := ZMod 2
  let n := 6*t
  let a := 3*t
  let W := Fin n → F
  letI : Fintype (Submodule F W) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let next := fun i : Fin n =>
    (⟨(i.val+1) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) i.isLt)⟩ : Fin n)
  let h := fun (i : Fin n) (b : Fin 4) =>
    if i.val % 2 = b.val / 2 ∧ (i.val / 2 % 3 = b.val % 2 ∨ i.val / 2 % 3 = 2)
    then (1:F) else 0
  let good := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ b : Fin 4, (∑ i, h i b * x i) = 0) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i, x i * y (next i) = x (next i) * y i)
  let supp := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => ∃ x ∈ U, x i ≠ 0)
  let spaces := (Finset.univ : Finset (Submodule F W)).filter good
  let layer := spaces.filter (fun U : Submodule F W => Module.finrank F U = d)
  let B := ∏ i ∈ Finset.range d, (2^d-2^i : ℕ)
  let s := (2 : ℝ)^d
  let lane := fun b : Fin 2 => Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val % 2 = b.val)
  let runs := fun S : Finset (Fin n) => (S.filter (fun i => next i ∉ S)).card
  let model := fun S : Finset (Fin n) =>
    (if S = lane 0 then s^(a-2) else 0) + (if S = lane 1 then s^(a-2) else 0) +
    (s-1)^(runs S)/s^4
  let actual := fun S : Finset (Fin n) => (B : ℝ) *
    ((layer.filter (fun U => supp U = S)).card : ℝ)
  (∑ S : Finset (Fin n), |actual S - model S|)/(∑ S : Finset (Fin n), model S))
    Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

changed.title: Exact nonlinear fan-in-two gate prices through four independent odd control planes at depth one with arbitrary even-weight pencils
changed.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
  xor (xor (g.op.eval [false, false]) (g.op.eval [false, true]))
      (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depths := fun (width : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  C.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun a => ds.getD a 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate width 0)
let F := ZMod 2
∀ (q l : ℕ) (s : Fin l → ℕ),
  let V := Fin q → F
  let I := Σ i : Fin l, Fin (s i)
  let T := Matrix I I F
  let dot := fun (a z : V) => ∑ j, a j * z j
  ∀ (a b : Fin l → V), (∀ i, a i ≠ 0 ∧ b i ≠ 0 ∧ a i ≠ b i) →
    ∀ (U W : (i : Fin l) → Matrix (Fin (s i)) (Fin (s i)) F),
      (∀ i, (U i).rank = s i ∧ (W i).rank = s i ∧ (U i + W i).rank = s i) →
      ∀ S : Submodule F T, S = Submodule.span F {A : T | A ∈ S ∧ A.rank ≤ 2} →
        let line := fun i : Fin l => ({a i, b i, a i + b i} : Finset V)
        let lines := Finset.univ.image line
        let mass := fun H : Finset V => ∑ i, if line i = H then s i else 0
        let N := ∑ i, s i
        let free := Module.finrank F S
        let K := fun z : V =>
          Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i => dot (a i) z • U i + dot (b i) z • W i)
        let w := Fintype.card (I ⊕ I)
        let coord := Fintype.equivFin (I ⊕ I)
        let table := fun (A : T) (z : V) (x y : Fin (w+1)) =>
          let X := Matrix.fromBlocks A (K z) (K z).transpose (0 : T)
          Fin.cases false (fun i => Fin.cases false (fun j =>
            decide (X (coord.symm i) (coord.symm j) ≠ 0)) y) x
        let bank := fun t : ℕ =>
          ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (tap : T → V → ℕ),
            PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack ((w+1)+(w+1)) C ∧
            (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ C.gates.countP nonlinear ≤ t ∧
            ∀ A ∈ S, ∀ z : V,
              (depths ((w+1)+(w+1)) C).getD (tap A z) 0 ≤ 1 ∧
              PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (table A z) ⟨C.gates, tap A z⟩
        let odd := lines.filter (fun H => mass H % 2 = 1)
        let g := odd.card
        (∀ z : (H : ↥odd) → V, (∀ H, z H = 0 ∨ z H ∈ H.val) →
          (∑ H, z H) = 0 → ∀ H, z H = 0) →
        (∀ t : ℕ, bank t → free ≤ t ∧
          3*N + min g (if g % 2 = 0 then 4 else 3) ≤ 2*(t-free)) ∧
        ∀ t : ℕ, free + (3*N+g)/2 ≤ t → bank t
